title: 8470 Won for a Kiss
description: Read manhwa online He Will Kiss You for 8,470 Won, 8470원만 주면 KISS 해주는 놈, 8470원만 주면 키스해 주는 놈, KISSの値段はおいくら？ at manhwa website A brilliant Gen Z icon and top-tier influencer, Yoo Hansol. One day, her life takes a dramatic nosedive when a sensationalist news channel falsely frames her as a school violence bystander, completely destroying her public image. As the baseless rumors spiral out of control, Yoo Hansol drops out of school and disappears from the public eye. Just as she’s preparing for a comeback—putting her faith in the so-called “six-month rule”—she slips, falls… and dies. But when she opens her eyes, she’s become the female lead of a novel?! Her heart flutters at the idea of becoming the heroine in a romance fantasy novel she once loved—only to be crushed when she realizes she’s actually been reincarnated into a 2000s internet fiction world. “From today onward, this girl is the official lackey of Baek Hosu!” —Baek Hosu As if things weren’t bad enough, she ends up being targeted by Baek Hosu, the top-ranked member of the school’s infamous “Four Heavenly Kings”…! Can Yoo Hansol overcome this absurd ordeal and survive in the chaotic world of an internet novel?
